title: The Simple Path to Wealth | JL Collins | Talks at Google
summary: Author JL Collins discusses his book The Simple Path to Wealth at Google, covering avoiding debt, simple index fund investing, and retirement accounts like 401(k)s and IRAs. It is an hour-long interview in plain language.
why: HN points people to it as the clearest single video on simple, long-term index fund investing.

quote.text: This video is probably the most clear resource I can think of that has all the information in one place.
